title: Markdown lite
skill: Give the order of steps and the exact output

good:
Rewrite render(md) in mdlite.py. Steps: 1) html.escape(md) first (quote=True, so " is " and ' is '; an existing & becomes &); 2) go line by line and strip each line; 3) a line that matches "# ", "## " or "### " plus text is a heading on its own:

..

,

,

, text stripped; "#### x" and "#x" are paragraph text; 4) other lines form paragraphs; a blank or whitespace-only line ends a paragraph; join the lines of one paragraph with one space:

..

; 5) join all blocks with "\n", no newline at the end; empty input gives ""; 6) inline, in headings and paragraphs: [text](url) where url has no spaces or ")" becomes text only when url starts with http:// or https:// (ignore case), else only the text; then **x** becomes x, then *x* becomes x. Keep the signature. Do not change comments.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Make the markdown renderer safe against XSS.
